bio: Dunston Hall is a beautiful 4-star hotel, set within 150 acres of stunning wooded Norfolk parkland, the perfect setting to enjoy a sumptuous Afternoon Tea in Norwich.  An Elizabethan-style mansion built in 1859, Dunston Hall has been lovingly restored to all its former glory.  You will be treated to an array of delicious savouries and sweet treats all washed down with a reviving hot drink. If you're in an extra indulgent mood, why not add a glass of champagne?!
